# Prompt Snippets

This directory contains reusable prompt snippets that can be referenced in your conversations with AI coding assistants.

## How to Use

Include these snippets in your prompts by referencing them or copying relevant sections.

## Available Snippets

### Security Snippet
For security-focused development and reviews.

### Performance Snippet
For performance optimization tasks.

### Testing Snippet
For test-driven development and test writing.

### Documentation Snippet
For documentation generation and updates.

## Example Usage

When asking an AI assistant to review code for security:
"Please review this code using the security guidelines from our prompt snippets."

When implementing a new feature:
"Implement this feature following our testing and security snippets."
